_why: Every ship refusal that a cheap local check could have caught is recorded here, with the check that now catches it. preship.py runs every named check. Adding a lesson is one entry; the law test_every_preship_lesson_names_a_check_that_runs refuses a lesson whose check does not exist or is not run.

lessons.reason: Mac pre-push render_check refused after a full CI round: the page floor was 6, the page had 7 zero-size boxes (the shelf overlay REG-3532 moved beside the other closed modals).
The render_check page floor was raised to 7, but test_a_chronicle_title_never_shaves_its_count still pinned 6, so the agent tests went red after another full CI round.

CI went green, then the Mac pre-push console-demos gate refused because node tv/demo_console.mjs could not find playwright in the ship worktree (~/Desktop/verify-evidence/wt-bundle had no node_modules; the main checkout had it).
